question: What was PROJ-275 about?

systems.stop_reason: single-pass, one follow-up hop + question-ID exact match

answers.flat-RAG:
PROJ-275 was about a minor cosmetic fix: a typo flagged by customer support in the footer of the order confirmation email template, where "Thank you for you order" was missing the word "your."

The fix was implemented in PR-495 ("Fix typo in order confirmation email footer"), which corrected the text to "Thank you for your order." Per the ticket comments from Yuki Tanaka, the PR was merged and deployed with the next scheduled release.
